response.sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS overall_avg FROM transaction_averages), kept AS (SELECT t.transref, t.avg_anlycount FROM transaction_averages t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.avg_anlycount > o.overall_avg), kept_overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.transref, k.avg_anlycount, k.avg_anlycount - o.overall_avg AS above_overall_avg, k.avg_anlycount - ko.kept_avg AS above_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN kept_overall ko ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
